orientation: outside half: rotation 0, outward is UP: nozzles point up into space; the exhaust glow overhangs above the frame (see glow.offset); the bottom 4px are the flange onto the outer wall face
notes: Scrapper Clans "Kickjet", a hull mount (outward is up): ONE oversized dented bell outside with a rust patch, a rusty fuel tank strapped on beside it, a patched mismatched wall collar with hazard tape, and inside a squat motor block with a taped control box, warm lamps, a patched repair hatch and a taped power coupling. The jet flickers unevenly. Damaged: the lower strap snapped and the tank sags and weeps fuel, the bell patch lost a bolt and the dent is on fire, the core sparks. Disabled: the bell broken off its neck and lying beside it, the tank slid off and split, the collar cracked, the core dead. THIS FILE: the OUTSIDE half (nozzles, in space against the outer wall face; its bottom 4px are the flange onto the wall). It is never destroyed, only disabled (bent, dead, fixable).
